sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    greens=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            greens.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2, b[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]))
    pb=[n['boundary'] for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='p']
    return {'greens':greens,'purple':pb}
print('before', state())
r=action(['UP']); print('after UP', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
r=action(['DOWN']); print('after DOWN', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
